messages:
maria: Heads-up 1  dashboard spike for last week's webinar shows big RSVP volume but downstream QL drop. Can @jamal pull source-level attribution and routing? We need a short blurb for the KPI review.

jamal: On it. Quick read: organic RSVPs conv 7.8% with QL 2.9%. Paid RSVPs conv 11.9% but QL only 2.4%. Looks like we boosted top-funnel but quality dipped.

alex: Possible routing TTL issue  mid-funnel leads set to `nurture` for 48h. I can change the playbook to immediate routing for `webinar_reg` for 24h and add a fallback to dedicated route if SDRs backfill. Any objections?

priya: No objections. Also saw messaging A (CTA: "Start free trial") pulled higher clicks during event vs B ("Book demo") which may drive volume but lower intent. Recommend swapping retarget creative to emphasize qualification.

tayla: FYI paid spend +19% that week; prospecting mix was broader. CPL +21%. I think tightening lookalike thresholds will help reduce low-intent signups.

dashbot: Snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/weekly/kpi/1744507890 includes cohort table and source attribution CSV.

jamal: SQL used for the snapshot: ```SELECT source, count(*) as rsvps, sum(case when qualified then 1 else 0 end) as ql FROM webinar_signups WHERE event_date between '2026-03-15' and '2026-03-21' GROUP BY source;``` Numbers in the dash link.

maria: Plan: Alex flip routing for 24h and monitor SDR queue; Priya rotate retarget creative to variant B and measure 72h; Jamal prep 3-slide breakout for KPI review: 1) attribution split, 2) routing simulation, 3) recs.

alex: Flipping now. Adding safeguard: if SDR queue > 50 then route to `dedicated-route`. Will post status after 30m.

jamal: Preparing slides and a cohort `webinar > 3 interactions` retention view. Also noting a UTM mapping parity issue between GA and CRM  will include in notes.

priya: Drafting two ad copy variants, posting in #marketing by 3pm. Options: "Cut inference costs by 40%" vs "Ship features faster"  leaning to the first for retarget.

tayla: Budget doc updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/ads/q2  reduced prospecting by 10% and increased retarget. Monitoring CPA.

maria: Good. Sync at 10am KPI review. If any severe drops before then @jamal escalate to oncall list. :thumbsup:
